svg.title: Cedar Service Assistant (C-24) delegating advice to the Dispatch Advisor through Cedar's A2A agent C-57
svg.desc: Sami and Lina chat with the Copilot Studio agent C-24 Cedar Service Assistant in Teams. C-24 keeps its tools Work order status (agent flow C-43) and Subcontractor service levels (gateway, end-user credentials) and gains one connected agent, Cedar Dispatch Advisor, of type A2A. For an advice question C-24 sends an A2A JSON-RPC message to the Azure Container App ca-cedar-advisor-dev, component C-57, signed in with OAuth 2.0 as the user, carrying the delegated scope Dispatch.Read for api://cedar-dispatch-advisor. Inside C-57, Container Apps authentication returns 401 without a token, the RequirePermission middleware returns 403 without Dispatch.Read, the executor builds the question from the message text and at most a work order number from the user's history, and the guard GD-1 to GD-5 lets through only checked answers, otherwise the rules-only fallback; if Foundry fails, the rules-only answer is returned as degraded; one audit line is written per request. C-57 calls the Foundry agent cedar-dispatch-advisor through the agent's stable Responses endpoint with its managed identity, which holds Foundry Agent Consumer at the scope of that one agent. The agent's endpoint is pinned to evaluated version 3, speaks only the responses protocol in Cedar-Test and Cedar-Prod, and uses Entra authorization. Foundry calls the MCP server C-56 with the agent identity and the app role Dispatch.Read. A dashed, rejected path goes from C-24 directly to the Foundry agent through Copilot Studio's Foundry connection, which is preview and needs the Activity protocol; it is blocked outside Cedar-Dev by release check EP-2, because the answer would skip the guard.
svg.text: Release 2: advice inside the Teams chat, behind Cedar's guard (ADR-019)

so this path fails with HTTP 400.
• A deterministic check can't run inside Copilot Studio's orchestrator, so it runs in front of the model (C-57).
• Two identities, two permissions: people prove Dispatch.Read to C-57; C-57 alone may call the Foundry agent.
• The only door to the model is a Cedar host: protocols other than responses stay off, the version is pinned.
